svg.text: Total 15.5 kg = 3.0 g × (6.55 − 1.39) kg, elliptic along the span: 1.64 / 1.59 / 1.49 / 1.33 / 1.08 / 0.62 kg per side.

svg.text: Pass: tip deflection 120 mm or less, residual 2 mm or less, joiner straight, no foam crush, stops intact.
